network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ARPACAL include l'idrogramma dell'Allaro a Caulonia per l'evento, ma non tabula il colmo né fornisce i dati numerici della serie. ARCUS conserva l'esistenza della misura come contesto documentale, senza digitalizzare il grafico o attribuire falsa precisione al ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPACAL report includes the Allaro at Caulonia event hydrograph but does not tabulate the peak or provide the numerical series. ARCUS retains the measurement's existence as documentary context without digitising the plot or assigning false precision to the bridge.

curation_note.it: Il rapporto ARPACAL include l'idrogramma dell'Allaro a Caulonia per l'evento, ma non tabula il colmo né fornisce i dati numerici della serie. ARCUS conserva l'esistenza della misura come contesto documentale, senza digitalizzare il grafico o attribuire falsa precisione al ponte.
curation_note.en: The ARPACAL report includes the Allaro at Caulonia event hydrograph but does not tabulate the peak or provide the numerical series. ARCUS retains the measurement's existence as documentary context without digitising the plot or assigning false precision to the bridge.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
